title: A Parseval-Prefix Improvement for Erdős' Minimum-Overlap Problem
description: Preliminary and unrefereed computer-assisted certificate supporting the proposed composite lower bound c_E > 0.3805603. The new central two-bin computation is checked with directed-rounding MPFR; the remaining 170 bins use SHA-256-pinned reports from Price's upstream Arb computation. This is not a solution of Erdős Problem 36, has not been independently reproduced, and is not Lean-verified.
